q: What is the analysis grain in the integrated capstone?
why: The main encounter dataset is encounter-grain.

q: What is the Q1 2026 date filter used in the project?
why: A half-open interval avoids end-of-day boundary ambiguity.

q: Why compare Python and R outputs?
options: To identify implementation differences under identical definitions
why: Cross-tool agreement supports computational consistency, not source validity.

q: What does SBP completeness use as denominator?
why: Completeness is nonmissing SBP divided by all eligible encounter records.

q: Can this synthetic descriptive project support a causal claim?
why: Synthetic descriptive records do not establish causal effects.

q: Which item is essential in a professional handoff?
options: Dependencies, run commands, outputs, tests and limitations
why: A handoff should let another analyst reproduce and assess the work.
